clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Bethor Iceshard needs an agent for a mission involving a wayward lich. After your work in Brill against Scourge remnants and Rot Hide gnolls, Magistrate Sevren sends you south with orders.

Magistrate Sevren judges you worthy of greater Forsaken work after your service in Brill. He sends you to Bethor Iceshard, a formidable mage in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, who wants an agent tested against the Scourge. Sevren gives you official orders to carry beneath the ruins of Lordaeron, into the corridors of the Forsaken capital.

Magistrate Sevren does not know the exact details, but the orders concern finding and recruiting a rogue lich. Liches are among the Scourge's deadliest spellcasters, and dealing with one is perilous. You bring the orders to Bethor atop his arcane sanctum. The icy mage gets straight to business, ready to see whether Brill's magistrate has sent someone strong enough to track such dangerous quarry.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful adventurer in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge. You, friend, will be that agent.
Present these orders to Bethor. He will then instruct you on your mission. I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich. And it will be dangerous.
So ready yourself, adventurer. You must not fail.
You may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings. Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.
Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you are the agent sent by Magistrate Sevren. Then yes, your business with me is crucial.
I trust Sevren has mustered someone suitable for my task...but we shall see.
